title: Prove the fixed L/2 firing set's first all-sound length for every n >= 5: L*(n) = 2^n - 2 floor(sqrt(2^(n-1)-1)), with explicit firing words one step below (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/f7-firing-threshold-all-n/`. For every `n ≥ 5`, it proves the first even length at which the fixed `L/2` substitution of #4322 fires on no universal canonical word:

```text
L*(n) = 2^n - 2 floor(sqrt(2^(n-1) - 1))      (26, 54, 114, 234, 482, 980, ... ; 2^n − L* ≈ 2^((n+1)/2))
```

From `L*(n)` up to `2^n`, every functional is sound on **every** `L`-point subset. At `L*(n) − 2`, a weight-one mask fires on an explicit word.

This answers #4322's open question 3: the collapse recurs at every `n`. It also settles #4322's remark that neither of its results shows "the firing set eventually becomes empty for every n". The value at `n = 5` matches the census in #4348.

**Claim type: a proof for every n ≥ 5, with finite checks and explicit witnesses. No new κ.**

## Proof outline (README)

1. **Min-sumset cap.** By Kneser's theorem in `F_2^k`, `|A+A| ≥ 2^⌈log₂|A|⌉`. So a `k`-point side of a level set has excess at most `e(k) = C(k,2) − 2^⌈log₂k⌉ + 1`.
2. **The binding split.** It is a full level set against the rest. With `s = 2^(n−1)` and `L = 2(s−j)`, `base − cap = (s−1) − j²`. For `n ≥ 6` both parts lie in `(2^(n−2), 2^(n−1)]` at every `L ≥ L*`, and the cap is convex there, so no other split binds.
3. **Sharpness.**
   - Traverse all of `{x_1 = 0}` along a reflected Gray cycle.
   - Make a "ladder" detour through `t = s − 2j` points of `{x_1 = 1}`.
   - Then `e_1` has excess exactly `e(s) + e(t)`, which lies in `(base, base + j²]`, so it fires.

## Evidence

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Min-sumset lemma and cap | exhaustive in `F_2^k`, `k ≤ 4` (all 65,536 subsets at `k = 4`); the cap is attained |
| Full split scan | 6, 14, then exactly the closed form for every `5 ≤ n ≤ 22` |
| Explicit words at `L*(n) − 2`, `n = 5..11` | simple, closed, universal and firing, also after canonical relabeling |
| Controls of length `L*(n)` | nothing fires |
| #3733's `(4,12)` on main | still fires, so the `n = 4` threshold 14 is attained |

Standard library only; runs in about 6 seconds.

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/f7-firing-threshold-all-n --check-only
  PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/f7-firing-threshold-all-n
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/f7-firing-threshold-all-n outcome=completed
```

Head: `bc720388557ac1c2f7f8fe89807ccb7769102676`.

## Not covered

- Which masks fire below `L*(n) − 2`.
- `(7, 18)` and `(7, 20)`, which lie far below `L*(7) = 114`.
- Any retained exclusion.

## Task and overlap

- Card: `census-pruning-audit`, refined, priority revision 7.
- Base: canonical main `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`.
